mediaWork.title: 13 Alibis
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Investigates the wrongful murder conviction of Richard Rosario despite 13 alibi witnesses placing him in Florida.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Dateline NBC original investigative podcast reported by producer Dan Slepian following the 20-year fight to free Richard Rosario, who was convicted of a 1996 Bronx murder despite 13 witnesses placing him 1,000 miles away in Florida, leading to the 2016 vacatur of his conviction.
mediaWork.availabilityNotes: Apple Podcasts · Public RSS feed verified · ~10 episodes on Apple Podcasts
